fields.label: Request Id
fields.description: The mobile app's own client-generated requestId (uuid) -- becomes this doc's name directly, so a retried create POST with the same requestId resolves to the same batch rather than creating a duplicate.

fields.label: Device Id
fields.description: Paired with each Offline Sync Item's (entity_type, reference_id) to form the real idempotency key -- reference_id alone is only unique per device, not globally.

fields.label: Provider
fields.description: The authenticated caller (resolved server-side via current_remote_user_id() -> Provider.username, never trusted from client-supplied userId) -- the practitioner of record for every Assessment row in this batch.
